business_summary: Tokai Rika Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive parts in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. The company offers human interface systems and controls, including shift levers; touchpads; multi-function, power window, steering, heater control, push start, hazard, fog lamp, power outer mirror, defogger, rheostat light control, and seat switches, as well as neutral start, engine oil pressure, parking brake, door lock, brake lamp, courtesy lamp, and buckup light sensing switches. It also provides security systems, such as smart key portable device and emergency keys, electronic key systems, powered/mechanical steering lock assemblies, immobilizers, remote keys, and key sets; and safety systems comprising seatbelts, steering wheels, door mirrors, and digital outer mirrors. In addition, the company offers electronic systems, such as power supply ECUs, immobilizer ECUs, speed and steering angle sensors, and custom ICs; and wheel covers, center caps, and emblems. Further, it provides entrance electric door locks and window lock monitoring systems; SMT and board lock connectors; auto alarms; and digital keys. Tokai Rika Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Niwa, Japan.
